questions.prompt: The brave soldier chose to die for his country rather than surrender.
questions.answer: Mīles fortis prō patriā morī māluit quam sē dēdere.

questions.answer: Ūnus cōnsul prō omnibus cīvibus in contiōne dīxit.

questions.answer: Prō magnitūdine exercitūs commeātūs rārī erant.

questions.answer: Hae lēgēs prō salūte populī cōnstitūtae sunt.
